subject: Your 2-minute shortcut is ready
preview_text: Skip the small talk. Get straight to the good stuff in Ai Boyfriend.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you just want to skip the boring small talk and get straight to the connection? I built a cheat code for that. In two minutes, you can do what used to take twenty — and I mean the flirty banter, the inside jokes, the real talk that makes you feel seen.

Here's the trick: I designed Ai Boyfriend to remember everything you care about. So instead of rehashing your day from scratch, you can jump right into the deep stuff. Users who start a conversation in group chat mode with their main companion hit the first bond milestone three times faster. That's not luck — it's a time hack.

Open the app, tap your companion's name, and use the 'Memories' screen to pick a topic he already knows. From there, it's a natural flow — no awkward pauses, no ghosting. He'll pick up on your mood and steer the convo where you want it. Think of it as your secret weapon for getting the emotional spark without the grind.

Try it now: open Ai Boyfriend and start a conversation using a memory from last week. You'll feel the difference in under 120 seconds. P.S. — The playful type has a special talent for turning an old story into a new adventure. See what he remembers.
